message.content:
**神舟八号（Shenzhou 8）** 是中国空间计划中的一次无人试验飞行，主要用于验证与天宫一号（Tianhe）对接系统的功能。它于 2008 年 9 月 25 日发射，整个任务没有携带任何宇航员。

> **关键点**  
> - **发射日期**：2008‑09‑25  
> - **任务类型**：无人试验飞行  
> - **目的**：验证 Shenzhou 航天器与天宫一号的对接技术  
> - **宇航员**：无（无人飞行）

如果你想了解后续有人类乘坐的 Shenzhou 9、10、11 等载人飞行，或者想知道 Shenzhou 8 的技术细节（如对接成功率、轨道高度等），随时告诉我！
message.reasoning: The user asks in Chinese: "神舟八号的宇航员是谁" meaning "Who were the astronauts on Shenzhou 8?" They want the names of the crew of Shenzhou 8. We need to answer. According to known info: Shenzhou 8 was a Chinese spaceflight in 2008, part of the Shenzhou program. It was a test flight with a robotic probe, not a crewed flight. Actually Shenzhou 8 was an unmanned test flight of the Shenzhou spacecraft, launched on 25 September 2008. It was a test of the docking system. It had no crew. So answer: It was an unmanned test flight, no astronauts. Provide explanation. Also mention that Shenzhou 8 was a test flight of the Shenzhou spacecraft, no crew. Provide details.
